description: The main window's whole capability set. It grants SAM's own commands (which are permission-free by construction) and Tauri's core defaults, and nothing else — there is deliberately no `fs:` or `sql:` entry, because neither plugin is a dependency of the shell. Every read and write therefore crosses a `sam-core` command, which is the same path the CLI takes (§4.6 one write path, §4.10).
